method: Retrospective paired full-path checkpoint score on exact connected source-target journeys. No fitting; no automatic pass/fail. Repeated checkpoints and source contexts share target visits. Arrival labels are detector/GPS proxies, not verified doors. Early actual arrival relative to forecast does not itself establish a missed rider connection.

input.normalization: Clip finite wire eta/low/high to zero as rider adapter does at zero elapsed; preserve Raw arm values
